protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

constraints: Identical to DOM Create XML element except that attribute names/values are passed as parallel arrays (already created and sized beforehand) instead of scalar pairs; you can pass as many array pairs, and as many elements per pair, as needed.
attribValuesArray may be of Text, Date, number, or Picture type; 4D converts values to text automatically (configurable via XML SET OPTIONS).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a new XML element at a given XPath location under elementRef, setting attributes from parallel name/value arrays, and returns its reference.
